remarks: OPEN HOUSE SUNDAY 10/11/26 1:00 PM - 2:30 PM. Welcome to 9378 Clipnock Rd! Discover the comfort and convenience of single story living in a country setting. This spacious 3 bed, 2 full bath ranch sits on a beautiful .43 acre lot in Stafford! Offering 1,144 sqft of living space, this home features a functional layout with plenty of room to make it your own. The bright and welcoming living room showcases a beautiful bay window that fills the space with natural light, while the kitchen offers ample functionality with included appliances, pantry storage, and views of the backyard. Enjoy the convenience of 1st floor laundry located in the updated bathroom, along with an enclosed porch that provides additional space to relax or unwind. Looking for even more room? The full basement features a second full bath and partially finished space, offering endless possibilities for a recreation room, home office, workout area, or additional living space. Outside, you'll appreciate the attached garage, vinyl siding, durable metal roof, and poured concrete foundation. With its practical layout, generous lot, and room to add your personal touches, this home offers a wonderful opportunity to make it your own. Don't miss your chance to see everything this ranch has to offer. Don't delay, schedule your showing today!
